edits.find:
- name: Install package + test deps
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .
          pip install --require-hashes -r tests/requirements.txt
      - name: Run the full test suite
        run: python -m pytest tests/ -v
edits.replace:
- name: Install package + test deps
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .
          pip install --require-hashes -r tests/requirements.txt
      # Several tests shell out to these. Without them the tests do not skip --
      # they FAIL, and they had been failing on every matrix job since the tools
      # were only ever installed in the separate lint/shellcheck jobs:
      # test_command_bash_parse (5 tests) needs shellcheck,
      # test_fleet_skill_phase_a::test_the_ops_engine_is_actually_clean needs ruff.
      - name: Install shellcheck (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y shellcheck
      - name: Install shellcheck (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: brew install shellcheck
      - name: Install ruff
        run: pip install ruff
      - name: Run the full test suite
        run: python -m pytest tests/ -v
